title: Day 2: a lighter evening outdoors, and door cards for the time of day
caption: After work on day 2 the outdoor places were too dark on a phone. The same dusk is now lifted (more sky light, a stronger low sun and fill, a brighter grade), so people and paths read; the lamps and lit windows stay warm. Day 1's evening is unchanged. The shut shops now show a card for the time of day: 準備中 in the morning, 本日休業 after work, the izakaya's 本日貸切 on its curtain and the onsen's boiler-repair notice. Each pair is before | after. Second pass (below): the door cards now show on screen when you try a door, the lamp pools are warm again, and dark-clothed people read against the dusk.

sections.title: Door cards
sections.caption: Close-ups with the camera moved in front of the doors (Eric's hair is in some). Rows: day 1 after work (unchanged), day 2 morning, day 2 after work.

sections.title: Second pass, phone
sections.caption: 390 x 844. Before | after. The street lamps' warm pools are stronger again, the plaza a little darker, and people in dark clothes keep their shape (a lift of their own colours and a soft rim of sky light on the people only).

sections.title: Second pass, door cards in play
sections.caption: Trying a shut door now shows its card beside the line, as it hangs at that time of day. Day 1 and day 2, every shut door with a card.
